prompts.name: Standard Translation
prompts.notes: v13 + the whole of #3825, seeded non-default. (1) closed tag vocabulary — the 2026-08-09 census found 60-83 invented tag tokens per side; (2) verbatim original-notes — the phrase inside <note>original: "…"</note> is a character-for-character copy of the OCR input or the note is omitted (12.2% fabricated, #3308; 91% verified, #4695); (3) no standalone glossary lines, <keywords> is the only end-of-page list; (4) OCR housekeeping tags (vocab/lang/page-type/page-num/sig/scan-quality) are input, never output; (5) duplicate 8/9 numbering fixed, style rules scoped to all translator-authored prose. Consumer surfaces checked in the seeding script's header (NotesRenderer, build-book-index, learn route, download routes). Flip only after scripts/eval/translation-prompt-ab.mjs under PREREGISTRATION-translation-prompt-v15.md. Rollback: nothing to roll back while non-default.
